meta.description: Registry for handling exact degenerate minima under recursive selection dynamics in Phase 3.

degenerate_resolution_entries.name: Degenerate Minima Resolution
degenerate_resolution_entries.purpose: Represent bounded tie-resolution behavior under admissible recursive selection without collapsing nondeterministic continuation structure.

degenerate_resolution_conditions.name: equivalent_local_minima_detectable
degenerate_resolution_conditions.description: Selection metrics must be capable of identifying multiple candidates with identical extremal values.

degenerate_resolution_conditions.name: multi_branch_retention_permitted
degenerate_resolution_conditions.description: Process framework must allow concurrent actualization or tracking of multiple admissible paths.

degenerate_resolution_conditions.name: deterministic_collapse_not_required
degenerate_resolution_conditions.description: System does not force a unique choice among degenerate candidates unless explicitly constrained.

degenerate_resolution_conditions.name: orientation_bias_remains_bounded
degenerate_resolution_conditions.description: Any weighting or resolution rule must not result in divergent frame orientation drift.

degenerate_resolution_conditions.name: branch_pruning_preserves_required_witness
degenerate_resolution_conditions.description: Tie-resolution does not allow pruning of all valid candidates.

degenerate_resolution_conditions.name: transport_flux_remains_finite
degenerate_resolution_conditions.description: Propagation of multiple degenerate branches must remain within finite flux bounds.

degenerate_resolution_conditions.name: recursive_selection_remains_admissible
degenerate_resolution_conditions.description: Each step of tie-resolution must respect current admissibility windows.

degenerate_resolution_conditions.name: residue_accumulation_does_not_force_unique_resolution
degenerate_resolution_conditions.description: Historical traces do not automatically collapse future degeneracy into uniqueness.
